title: A ready PR that goes red and gets a lane push returns to draft first, and the tool or lane lint says so before the push
why: Debt named by runner 10 (08:02 CST Nov 14, relayed; triage read nothing): a ready PR that goes red and gets a lane push must return to draft first. Sighting on #3272 (coordinator 08:02): ready run red (checks-mutate-guard, test_guard_beat.py line 307), made draft again, lane fixing. Mistake it would stop: a lane pushing a fix to a PR that is still marked ready, so a fresh CI run starts on a PR the runner may still treat as ready. Harm: unmeasured. Fix: unbuilt; two candidates, (a) a refusal in the lane push path that says "this PR is ready and red; mark it draft first", (b) the runner or tool does it when a ready run ends red. Kin: pr-state-is-on-the-pr, lane-lint-unknown-on-ready-pr (not read). Ask the coordinator whether the draft step is already in the tool before a lane starts; this step may only need a rule line.
note: Filed 08:06 CST Nov 14 by triage. Tracker: the coordinator. No lane yet.
